_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: J. M. Rodwell (1808-1900). The Koran, in his chronological order of the suras (1861). PD. Added 2026-10-03 by lane C (round 6) under the coordinator's standing instruction to choose further translator shelves; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst. From archive.org (2026-10-23): his Prophecies of Isaiah, translated from the Hebrew (Norgate, second edition, 1886).

rodwell-koran.note: Rodwell orders the suras by his estimate of their chronology, not the traditional order; the unit id must carry the sura number, not the position.

rodwell-the-prophecies-of-isaiah.work: The Prophecies of Isaiah, translated from the Hebrew
rodwell-the-prophecies-of-isaiah.scan_edition: Frederic Norgate, London; Williams & Norgate, Edinburgh, 1886 (second edition)
